# ProgressRing

A compact completion ring for summaries on cards and in rows: how much of a goal is done (target tracks found 72%, library keyed 48%).

`SongNodes.ProgressRing` · Charts

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.ProgressRing value={0} size={…} label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.ProgressRing" value="{{0}}" size="{{…}}" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (ProgressRingProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` * | `number` | Completion 0–1. |
| `size` * | `24 \| 40 \| 64` | Ring size in px. |
| `label` * | `string` | Goal name, also the accessible name ("Library keyed"). |
| `detail` | `string` | Counts and what's left ("616 of 1,284 tracks"). |
